    Enrollment

    Enrollment at Kai Ming Head Start

    Our programs are dedicated to supporting underserved families in our community, including those facing economic challenges, children with special needs, children in foster care, and those experiencing homelessness.

    ​

    As a non-profit Head Start grantee, we aim to provide quality early education and support services to families who qualify under state and federal guidelines. All families with children aged 3 months to 5 years are encouraged to apply. We’ll carefully review each application to determine eligibility for our State and Federally funded programs.

    ​

    If you need any additional information, please contact our Enrollment Specialist at (415) 839-8222 or enroll@kaiming.org.

    Submit Inquiry
    Apply Online

    Our Enrollment Process

    Step 1: Inquire and Apply

    Get started in one of two ways: submit an inquiry or apply online.

    Alt: Download the physical form to fill out, and submit it via enroll@kaiming.org.

    ​

    Step 2: Review and Waitlist

    After your pre-application submission, we will contact you within 2 business days.

    We will review your application, assign priority based on your family’s specific needs and reported income, and place your child on the waitlist for the center(s) you’ve selected.

    ​

    Step 3: Intake and Enrollment

    Once your family is found eligible for a space and a vacancy is available, one of our Family Advocates will reach out to verify your information.

    Afterward, you’ll be invited to a formal intake appointment to complete enrollment and set a start date for your child!

    Eligibility for Our Program

    Kai Ming Head Start has different funding sources to support families with various needs. There are two ways to qualify: by your family’s situation or by household income. Use the quick check below to see where your family fits.

    Inquire or Apply

    Inquire or Apply Online

    Send us a quick inquiry, or complete the full pre-application online. You can also give us a call our staff will contact you to schedule an appointment.
